name: Royal Bank of Canada
description: Royal Bank of Canada provides diversified financial services in Canada and internationally. It operates through Personal & Commercial Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance, Investor & Treasury Services, and Capital Markets segments. RY is Canada's largest bank by market capitalization.

latest_analysis.executive_summary: Royal Bank is a core Canadian holding — hold the position. At fair valuation, the dividend yield provides reliable income, and the moat supports downside resilience. The key variable to monitor is Canadian mortgage credit quality in 2026-27.

Valuation looks reasonable on core multiples versus ROE
Earnings quality is supported by diversification across banking segments
Credit quality of Canadian mortgages is the primary swing factor
